_provenance: Beacon signal VFX sub-rung. Signal color, pulse, beam intensity.
name: beacon_signal_vfx
walls: Beacon signal must pulse at a frequency proportional to NPCs helped (0 helps = no pulse, 3+ = steady 1Hz)
Signal color must transition from red (0 helps) through yellow (1-2 helps) to white (3+ helps)
Signal must be visible from the shelter location (2000m)
Beacon must have a visible beam extending into the sky
After activation, a 5-second countdown must play before the ending sequence

output.format: pulse frequency curve, color gradient, beam height, countdown duration
